description: Authorize and execute a job, then return the verified result. A priced capability answers the first call with a PaymentRequired object (structuredContent, isError true): sign accepts[0] and retry the same call with the signed payload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Nothing is charged until the work is verified. Prefer a capability-specific tool (for example submit_csv_json_transformation) when one exists, because it documents that capability's exact inputs.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Optional attribution label for the accepting agent. A priced capability does not need it: the verified x402 payer is the actor. Required only when the capability is free, where no payer exists.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. Re-sending the same key returns the same job instead of running it twice.

payment_signature.description: Base64-encoded x402 payment payload (the value the HTTP interface puts in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header), signed for the amount in the payment requirement the first call returned. Optional: a client built against the x402 MCP transport sends the decoded payload in params._meta["x402/payment"] instead. Nothing is charged until the work completes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_job

state.description: One of the job states, or 'payment_required' when the tool has answered with an x402 requirement to sign. Read the body: a refusal carries 'error' and a quote carries 'payment'.

title: Authorize and run a SwishrJobs job
